title: Package Download Workflow
activity_flow: START: Installer triggers prepare(type, package, targetDir)
[preferDist=true or isDev()=false and no pattern override] → dist first
[prevPackage present and same source available] → keep previous source order
→ Loop: shift next source from list
→ [cache hit + valid checksum?] → cache.copyTo(cacheKey, fileName) → resolve(fileName)
→ loop URLs: doDownload(package, path, url, prevPackage) [abstract, e.g. GitDownloader]
→ [fail] → try next URL; [no more URLs] → rethrow
→ [sourceFallback=true AND more sources] → retry with next source (source↔dist fallback)
→ loop URLs: doInstall(package, path, url) [abstract, e.g. git clone]
→ [fail] → try next URL; [no more URLs] → rethrow
[FileDownloader.cleanup]: unlink tmp file, remove empty dirs
[FAILURE] → DownloadManager.cleanup() still called to remove partial artifacts
key_relationships: DownloadManager composes DownloaderInterface[] (by type string key)
DownloadManager delegates all operations to DownloaderInterface
FileDownloader depends_on HttpDownloader (async HTTP), Cache, EventDispatcher, Filesystem
VcsDownloader depends_on Filesystem, IOInterface; concrete subclasses add ProcessExecutor
DownloadManager uses Filesystem for directory setup and normalizeTargetDir
Source/dist selection: resolvePackageInstallPreference() uses packagePreferences patterns + isDev()
branching_conditions: preferSource flag → source before dist in getAvailableSources()
preferDist flag or isDev()=false → dist before source
cache hit (sha1 match) in FileDownloader → skip HTTP download
sourceFallback=true → retry with alternate source on RuntimeException
retries counter (3) in FileDownloader → retry same URL on network error
VcsDownloader.prepare update → stash local changes; cleanup update → reapply
DownloadManager.update: same downloader type → downloader.update(); different type → remove + install
important_notes: All public DownloadManager methods return PromiseInterface (React\Promise). Async HTTP via HttpDownloader.addCopy(). FileDownloader uses a tmp file (vendor/composer/tmp-{md5hash}.{ext}) for download, then renames on install. VcsDownloader.download() is decoupled from install() — download just fetches metadata/refs, install does the actual checkout (doInstall abstract). DownloadManager.download() source/dist fallback loop is separate from FileDownloader's per-URL retry loop. cleanup() is always called (success and failure) to remove temp artifacts.
